scope: Authoritative source tracing for rarity, factions, CV, origin, artwork and skins without inferred display values.

canonicalIdentity.reuseRule: Do not rebuild playable-Hero identity in Stage 5-5-2.

rarity.starMeaning: initial/current base star count; not the rarity label
rarity.coverage: 267/267 canonical Heroes resolve to a validated Rank value.
evidence: Rank 1 contains Matthew, Grenier and Almeda; their StarToRank data promotes Rank 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 as stars increase, directly establishing Rank as the rarity tier axis.
Rank 2 contains the canonical R Hero group such as Lester, Jessica, Rouga and Scott.
Rank 3 contains the canonical SR Hero group such as Chris, Narm, Hein and Altina.
Rank 4 contains the canonical SSR Hero group such as Leon and Ledin.
Rank 6 contains exactly the six current LLR Heroes: 빙설 심연의 지배자, 빛의 소환사, 염룡파멸자, 마안의 서큐버스, 빛과 어둠의 반역자, 효랑어홍사.
rarity.rule: Use Rank for rarity display. Use Star only for star count. ExchangedFragmentCount remains rejected because it is duplicate-acquisition fragment quantity, not the rarity enum.

factions.coverage: 267/267 canonical Heroes have at least one faction; zero SuperHero-not-member mismatches.
factions.rule: Use RelatedHeros_ID for membership. SuperHero_ID is faction-buff ownership and must not be used as membership.

cv.rule: Use CVName as the authoritative source field. For Hero IDs 99235, 99236 and 99276, source value ■■■■ is confirmed to mean no voice actor, not masked or unresolved actor data. Preserve all other source spellings as-is.

localization.scope: Chinese-localized CVName spellings -> Korean voice-actor display names
localization.rule: Do not auto-transliterate or rewrite actor names in ConfigData-derived artifacts. User will localize display names later.

origin.rule: Measure pointer coverage only. Do not map production IDs to work titles until an authoritative dictionary is validated.

artwork.rule: CharImage_ID is confirmed as a join pointer into ConfigDataCharImageInfo for CV, but final Hero-detail portrait/artwork field selection remains a separate semantic question.

skins.rule: Membership and ID resolution are validated; display ordering and GetPathType meaning remain unresolved until separately proven.

nonSynthesisPolicy: Unresolved fields stay null/review. Candidate field names and numeric values are not sufficient to create page-display values. Confirmed CVName source strings are preserved as-is; CV localization is explicitly deferred to a later user-managed localization step.
deferredTasks: Localize ConfigDataCharImageInfo.CVName source spellings into Korean voice-actor display names without changing the confirmed CV source join.
nextGate: Continue resolving remaining display semantics (origin dictionary, final artwork field, skin ordering/acquisition) without reopening confirmed rarity, faction or CV semantics.
